Module io.github.senthilganeshs.fj
Package io.github.senthilganeshs.fj.reactor

Class ReactorInterop

java.lang.Object
io.github.senthilganeshs.fj.reactor.ReactorInterop
public final class ReactorInterop extends Object
Reactor interop utilities that keep Reactor types confined to the bridge layer. Use these helpers at framework edges only. Domain and service code should continue to expose Task, TaskEither, ReaderTaskEither, and AsyncStream.
